usedFor: HeySummit holds attendees and tickets and Conversion Chats messages them when “Ticket Purchased” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Purchased” in HeySummit, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: The buyer gets a templated message sent through your Conversion Chats account, so confirmations do not depend on email.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” needs a recipient number, so check that your HeySummit registration collects one.
